pages.title: Shared Heart
pages.text: Two hearts of soul guards and two Roka horns bind your heart to everyone who dares to wound you. The draught lasts 1 minute.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Every creature that strikes you suffers half of the harm it poured into you, whether it comes at you with claws, blades or arrows. A shield that catches the blow catches its echo too.

pages.title: Recipe
notes: Place Somnium and loran energy in the upper input slots.
Place the required items in the test tubes on the left and right.
